scope: Instances of the Becoming core's laws in constructed peripheral machines. Reading acquired words: for every lexicon whose transition record groups the two-word encoding, every encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms exactly when each word form resolves to its atom (from Segmentation.reads_every_iff); the histories learned 32, coordinated 37, acquired 51, retrospective 36 and the fixed decoder of experienced 28 are instances, and the peripheral bond is the core's majority bond. Readout: the four-integer summary of the two-qubit fragment carries a law and is exact after every course of moves. Formed goal revision: a practice runs n cycles from an account exactly as the work covers the cycles the reserve does not support; every operation of the learning goal keeps the goal and selector and adds the transition loss if any; revision completes exactly under access loss with kept maintenance, after which n operations run exactly when n <= 5 (n <= 2 without reform) and the earlier loss is retained; the harmful headline is an instance. Gated change: the practice machine's traces are its completed runs, only revision changes the recorded methods and only an organizational adoption changes the rule. Correspondence of these machines to actual learners, quantum systems, people or organizations is not checked.
